TableS5.title: Supplementary Table S5 | Family-specific coefficients for converting amphipod biomass to frozen-equivalent energy density

parts.title: S5
headers: Formalin-preserved caloric content (kJ g⁻¹ dry weight)
Frozen caloric content (kJ g⁻¹ dry weight)

TableS5.note: Note. For each family, formalin-preserved wet-weight biomass density was multiplied by the dry-weight: wet-weight mass ratio, formalin-preserved caloric content and frozen: formalin caloric ratio to obtain frozen-equivalent energy density. Frozen caloric content is shown as the measured value underlying the preservation ratio. Values are rounded for display; analyses used the unrounded source coefficients. Exact coefficients were obtained from Marx 5; Hondolero et al. 6 and Wilt et al. 7 support the regional caloric-content and preservation-adjustment methods.
